super_admin.name: Super Admin (Developer)
super_admin.description: Master developer role with full wildcard access (*) to every single page, endpoint, modal, and button. Can never be restricted.

hod.name: Head of Department (HOD)
hod.description: Head of Department administrative role. Has full administrative power matching Super Admin, but CANNOT delete anything on this website (delete actions are strictly blocked).

sub_admin.name: Sub Admin
sub_admin.description: Departmental administrative observer. Can view all pages, lists, profiles, timetables, syllabi, reports, and inspect credentials, but CANNOT create, edit, delete, or toggle anything.

faculty.name: Faculty Member (Staff)
faculty.description: Academic faculty teaching staff. By default has access strictly to Dashboard, Calendar, Syllabus & Papers, Student Timetable, Workload Report, and Timetable. Other permissions can be added manually.
